spans.text: Late in the evening, a bright full moon hangs high in the night sky.
As fireworks bloom and stars twinkle, they leave behind shining bands of light on the surface of the rising tide.
Among the busy crowd, Kalina's cheerful voice stands out.
Hehe... Thanks for everyone's support!
None of the candidate Dolls could have made it this far without your help!
Looks like you’re having fun, Kalina.
The Commander walks into Kalina's stall and puts all their cards into the red ballot box.
Good evening, Commander!
It's now halfway past this wonderful night, and the competition is only getting fiercer!
Which side is more popular now?
Right now?
Hehe... Take a guess?
The Commander wants to the check the ballot result, and you're making them guess?
Unbeknownst to them, FAL had crept up behind the Commander, startling them unexpectedly.
Kalina winks, then pulls the Commander into the stall. With her index finger pressed against her lips, she shushes the Commander with a puzzling smile.
Commander, don't get me wrong.
While I'm not worried about the eventual victory of the Villagers...
It's just... given the scheming nature of my opponent, I just feel like it's necessary to inspect the ballot.
FAL, with the confidence of a protagonist, surveys her surroundings.
Finally, she lays her eyes on the red ballot box in front of Kalina.
Good evening, Commander, Miss Kalina.
Oh? If it isn't our beloved Leader. What brings you here?
Five-seven suddenly pops up from another stall.
In an instant, FAL turns pale. With her head raised, she quickly strikes a cold, condescending pose.
That's my question, Five-seven.
What do you hope to accomplish by stalking me all the way here?
Nobody's stalking you.
I'm just passing by and looking around.
The smile on Five-seven's face grows more sinister.
The Commander and Kalina glance at each other, sensing that a spark has been lit.
Heh, Commander, and Miss Kalina... The Werewolves should have more votes now, right? After all, the Commander promised to cast us more votes~
Impossible!
The Commander promised to help FF FN49 get rid of her "curse" by voting for the Villagers!
Right, Commander?!
Ah...
Well...
See, the Commander doesn't even bother with answering you!
You might as well admit defeat before the final result is announced, dear Leader.
You little...!
Please calm down, both of you!
The results of the ballot are still being tallied, so please hang around in other stalls before we—
Give it to me.
Eh?
Give me the ballot box!
Today I must show these girls that the Villagers under my lead are invincible!
FAL suddenly pounces directly at the red ballot box!
Yet just as her fingertip touches the box—
Kalina swiftly grabs the ballot box and starts running, until she immediately bumps into the Commander.
Pomf!
With a violent shock, dozens of cards are flung into the sky.
Don't you run away! Give them to me!
Kalina gracefully dodges from side to side with the ballot box in her arms, as if it's a game of whack-a-mole.
Even Five-seven is eyeing it like a hawk and approaching...
Hehe...
What? You too? Miss Five-seven...
You... Stay away!!!
As the chaotic sight unfolds before their eyes, the Commander sighs and steps forward.
Alright, you girls, don't make it hard for Kali—
A hand creeps up in the darkness and slips a tablet into the Commander's pocket.
What...
Kalina turns around and winks jovially.
Commander, I'll handle the situation here! You go about your businesses—
Waah! Stop! The votes are spilling out again!
Flutter—
Once again the cards are thrown sky high, as if they're some sort of bait.
As the crowd is dazzled, Kalina stares at the Commander.
When their eyes meet, the Commander suddenly understands what she wants.
The Commander gently nods and turns around without hesitation, sprinting out of the back door...
Huff... Huff...
Thankfully, no one came after me...
The Commander gasps for air while slowly checking their surroundings. After making sure prying no eyes, the Commander looks down and quietly opens the tablet.
Beep.
It's a message from Kalina.
Good evening, Commander!
The real-time ballot counting system is now ready for viewing on this tablet!
Hehe... Isn't my efficiency admirable?
But please note - the current vote counts aren't final.
If you want to alter the end result, please hurry up and cast your votes for your favorite T-Doll!
